purpose: Decorations extracted from the desktop mockup. These are FULL, correctly sized shapes for the 1440x900 layout. They replace every decoration that was reused from the mobile page, because the mobile files are pre-cropped for the mobile screen edges.
format: WebP with alpha, lossy, native mockup resolution (about 1.1x the design size).

stage.design: 1440 wide x H design px, s = min(viewportWidth/1440, 1.5, viewportHeight/780), H = viewportHeight/s (always >= 780)
stage.gtop_formula: Gtop = 148 + 0.475 * (H - 780), main group height 504 (Gtop is 205 at H = 900)

rules: Use ONLY these files for decorations on the desktop/tablet layout. Do not reuse any decoration file from the mobile page, except the two avatar+blob images of the hero.
The 5 corner decorations are anchored to the VIEWPORT corners (scaled by s) so they are always flush and never cropped by the wrong edge. The 6 hero decorations move with the main group.
All decorations are behind the text and buttons, pointer-events none, and must not overlap text, buttons or pills at any size in the test matrix.
